question: The Indian National Congress special session of September 1920 was held at ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Indian National Congress session of **September 1920** was held at **Calcutta**. 
 
• **Lala Lajpat Rai was the President** of this session. It was a special session.
 
• A special session was held **to pass the resolution of the Non-Cooperation Movement.**
 
• However, this session is also associated with Gandhi wrongly predicting that if the Non-cooperation movement gets successful, Swaraj could be attained in a year.
 
• The Non-cooperation movement was launched in 1920 by Mahatma Gandhi with the aim of Swaraj (self-governance). However, the movement was not successful.
